activities.title: Read about the Amazon and choose the right answer.

data.instructions: Read the text. Choose the correct answer.
data.text: The Amazon river is in South America. It is about six thousand four hundred kilometres long, and in the rainy season some parts are almost fifty kilometres wide! More kinds of fish live in the Amazon than in any other river — more than two thousand. Pink dolphins swim in its brown water. There are very few bridges over the Amazon, so people travel by boat between the villages.

data.voice_note: Voces: Maya (entrevista) y Kili (recuerdos de vuelo — narrados por Maya).
data.script: Maya: Kili, tell us about the rivers you know! … Maya: He says the Nile is the longest — about six thousand six hundred kilometres. … Maya: He flew over it for three days without stopping! … Maya: His favourite is the Amazon, because of the pink dolphins. … Maya: The coldest river he knows is in the north, full of ice in winter. … Maya: And the most beautiful bridge? The old stone bridge in our own town, of course! … Maya: Thank you, captain Kili, the best flying geographer!
